questions.question: Your recent work at Amentum used Microsoft Azure, Java 8, C#, and REST/JSON. Describe a backend REST API you designed or implemented there: its resource model, error handling, authentication approach, and how you kept it maintainable as requirements changed.

This role requires Java with Spring Boot and microservices, neither of which is specified in your profile. How would you design and implement a Spring Boot microservice that exposes a REST endpoint, validates requests, persists data, and is ready for production deployment?

Compare your Azure experience with the AWS capabilities needed here. How would you choose between AWS RDS and DynamoDB for a service, and what would you need to learn or validate before operating either in production?

The role involves an ESB and scalable REST/JSON/XML web-services layer. Given several legacy systems with different data formats, how would you design the integration boundary, version APIs, handle failures, and prevent one downstream system from affecting the others?

You developed interactive Highcharts.js visualizations at Experian and this role requires JavaScript graphing plus responsive applications. Walk us through a charting feature you built, including how you shaped the data, handled user interaction, and ensured it worked across screen sizes.

Describe how you would approach joining a codebase that uses Node.js, React, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Backbone.js, and Require.js—technologies not all shown on your profile—while delivering a meaningful feature in your first few weeks.

At T.Y. Lin International, you owned internal acceptance testing and maintenance-window testing for AT&T network sites. Tell us about a defect, risk, or unexpected result you identified, how you communicated it, and how you helped drive it to resolution.

This team works in agile delivery with testing, continuous deployment, Git, and Jenkins. What has been your direct experience with automated testing and release practices, and how would you add appropriate tests and CI checks for a change to a Java or web application?

You handled design, development, testing, reporting, documentation, and predictive analysis for energy-industry applications at Amentum. How did you translate a power-market or mobile-alert requirement for nontechnical stakeholders into an implementable solution, and how did you communicate results or limitations back to them?

This mid-level individual-contributor role asks for maintainable, scalable code and rapid iterative development. What attracts you to moving from your Azure-based full-stack and energy-domain work into this stack, and how would you balance learning gaps with delivering reliably on a remote team working EST hours?
